title: UAT-10147: Chinese-speaking adversary integrates agentic AI into post-compromise operations
summary: UAT-10147: Chinese-speaking adversary integrates agentic AI into post-compromise operations Cisco Talos Blog
body: UAT-10147: Chinese-speaking adversary integrates agentic AI into post-compromise operations Cisco Talos Blog
summaryZh: 思科Talos安全团队披露代号UAT-10147的威胁活动，指出有中文攻击者已将具有自主能力的智能体AI技术整合到系统被攻陷后的后渗透操作中，改变了传统攻击的自动化模式。原始信息显示：UAT-10147: Chinese-speaking adversary integrates agentic AI into post-compromise operations Cisco Talos Blog。该消息由Cisco Talos Blog发布，主题为“UAT-10147: Chinese-speaking adversary integrates agentic AI into post-compromise operations”。其重要性主要体现在：Cisco Talos披露了中文攻击团伙将智能体AI集成至入侵后操作中的真实案例，对安全研究和Agent滥用防范具有重大警示意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
